name: Encouragement
overview: Scripture reveals encouragement as a vital strength for believers, grounded in the assurance of God's presence and power. Joshua 1:9 commands strength and courage because the Lord is always with His people, while Isaiah 40:31 promises renewed strength for those who wait on the Lord. Christ’s victory over the world, highlighted in John 16:33, offers peace and a reason to be of good cheer amid trials. Additionally, Romans 15:13 and Philippians 4:13 emphasize that joy, hope, and the ability to endure come through the Holy Spirit and Christ’s strengthening power, encouraging both believers and pastors to persevere steadfastly.
